std.pattern: ^\[pid: (?<s_pid>\d+)\|app: (?<s_app>[\-\d]+)\|req: (?<s_req>[\-\d]+)/(?<s_worker_reqs>\d+)\] (?<c_ip>[^ ]+) \((?<cs_username>[^\)]*)\) \{(?<cs_vars>\d+) vars in (?<cs_bytes>\d+) bytes\} \[(?<timestamp>[^\]]+)\] (?<cs_method>[A-Z]+) (?<cs_uri_stem>[^ \?]+)(?:\?(?<cs_uri_query>[^ ]*))? => generated (?<sc_bytes>\d+) bytes in (?<s_runtime>\d+ \w+) \((?<cs_version>[^ ]+) (?<sc_status>\d+)\) (?<sc_headers>\d+) headers in (?<sc_header_bytes>\d+) bytes \((?<s_switches>\d+) switches on core (?<s_core>\d+)\)(?<body>.*)

s_pid.description: The ID of the worker process that handled the request

s_app.description: The ID of the application that handled the request

s_req.description: The number of the request within the worker

s_worker_reqs.description: The total number of requests the worker has handled

c_ip.description: The IP address of the client

cs_vars.description: The number of CGI variables in the request

cs_bytes.description: The size of the request's variables, in bytes

cs_uri_stem.description: The path part of the request URI

cs_uri_query.description: The query parameters in the request URI

sc_bytes.description: The size of the response, in bytes

s_runtime.description: The milliseconds it took to handle the request

sc_header_bytes.description: The size of the response headers, in bytes

s_switches.description: The number of async switches while handling the request

s_core.description: The core that handled the request

sample.line: [pid: 24386|app: 0|req: 482950/4125645] 86.221.170.65 () {44 vars in 1322 bytes} [Tue Jan  3 05:01:31 2012] GET /contest/log_presence/shhootter/?_=1325592089910 => generated 192 bytes in 21 msecs (HTTP/1.1 200) 4 headers in 188 bytes (1 switches on core 0)
